collection.title: Rover Streetwise 2003 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Rover Streetwise 2003 - 2005 requires a 18" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Streetwise which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
